squared_error_publication_rule: Ceiling on the declared grid plus one grid reserve. Source and audit certify complete L2 errors, not sample errors.
fourier_tail_anchor_policy: Double the exact positive anchor until the proved complete two-column BV/h tail upper is at most the target. Retain every attempted bound. No matrix or positivity search.
scope: Construct and independently qualify full supported source approximants for the existing constant and first odd mode. No full low matrix, Schur positivity or new support.
cell_enclosure: Midpoint source plus analytic full-cell derivative, with ambiguous arithmetic slabs separately enclosed. Same support, modes, residual terms, grid, precision and target as v1.
